title: Director of Brokerage Operations
text:
**Make your next move an expert one.**

At Colliers it’s not our success that sets us apart, it’s how we achieve it. Our people are passionate, take ownership and always do what’s right for our clients, people and communities.

**Why Colliers?**

Our enterprising environment needs your expertise to facilitate Colliers’ continued growth as an industry leader. Our nimble, decentralized culture can provide you with a wealth of opportunities to learn about our business and quickly gain experience to accelerate your career.

***\*\*this is an on-site opportunity based out of our Atlanta, GA office\* \****

 

**About the role**

The Director, Brokerage Operations will lead the effective and consistent delivery of operational excellence across the office and serve as the local integrator for the business. The role will lead through influence across a matrixed organization, coordinating local, regional and national resources to achieve business objectives around producers and the point of sale, regardless of reporting structure. The Director will oversee the day-to-day operating and administrative requirements for local business lines while maintaining clear accountability for outcomes.

As a key member of the local leadership team, the Director will organize enablement around winning business, recruiting, retention and producer effectiveness. The role will use the broader Colliers platform aggressively where it can deliver work better or more efficiently, while ensuring strong local execution and continuous improvement in service delivery.

 

**In this position, you will..**

* Lead and manage operations support employees across departments, ensuring service excellence, efficient delivery, clear accountability and continuous improvement in all service areas.
* Lead adoption of enterprise technology platforms, automation initiatives and process improvements to drive scalability, producer efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Bring strong operating and financial rigor to the business in collaboration with the local Managing Director, including P&L management, budgeting, forecasting, capital planning, financial analysis and resource allocation. Partner with Finance on transactional processes without making transactional Finance the center of the role.
* Serve as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director, supporting office revenue growth through producer recruiting, onboarding and integration, retention, producer productivity and pursuit conversion. Coordinate supporting resources and deliverables, including pitch books, recruiting materials and meeting preparation.
* Maintain an effective audit process to ensure local revenue recognition and other key controls are followed in accordance with company and GAAP guidelines.

* Partner with the local Managing Director on annual business planning, growth and market expansion, workforce planning and execution of strategic priorities, translating priorities into recommendations and action while ensuring corporate policies and procedures are followed.

* Operate proactively and decisively across a matrix, resolving issues at the appropriate level and making difficult calls rather than routinely pushing decisions upward.
* Integrate local, regional and national resources, including Client Services, analysts, People Services, Marketing, Research, IT, Operations and Finance, around producers and the point of sale. Leverage the broader Colliers platform for better, more efficient delivery while retaining clear local accountability.
* Responsible for partnering with corporate Human Resources on implementing Human Resources activities for all personnel including recruitment, selection, orientation, training, and performance management of the brokerage support team.
* Manage the administration and submission to People Services and/or Commission Payroll of all documentation for new and departing employees.
* Ensure effective workplace operations, facilities management and business continuity through appropriate delegation, vendor management and operational oversight.
* Conduct vendor product reviews and formulates expense approval decisions within the framework of corporate policies.
* Partner with Marketing on local business promotion and publicity activities, with Marketing retaining functional ownership, and oversee local office awards and recognition programs.
* Act as change and culture agent, supporting the vision and direction for the operations team by implementing new policies and procedures directed at continuous improvement and service excellence.
Other duties as required. 

 

**What you'll bring**

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) and 10+ years of progressive operational, commercial or business leadership experience in commercial real estate, professional services or a similarly decentralized business, with responsibility for business planning, financial performance, talent leadership and growth strategies.
* Proven track record leading operational transformation, process improvement, change management and service delivery initiatives across multiple functions.
* Knowledge of and adherence to Sarbanes-Oxley requirements and all company policies and procedures.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen in budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, business cases, performance measurement and P&L management; understands relevant economic indicators.
* Displays service excellence in dealing with internal and external clients and partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a highly matrixed environment, aligning local, regional and corporate stakeholders to deliver business outcomes. Proactive and decisive, with the ability to recommend, resolve issues and make difficult decisions.
* Excellent communication, organizational and prioritization skills.
* Strong aptitude for leveraging technology, automation, reporting tools, data analytics and scalable systems and processes to improve operational performance and business outcomes.
* Able to work under pressure, deal with multiple deadlines, effectively handle stressful situations and work with minimal direction/supervision.
* Demonstrates sound judgment, composure, adaptability, accountability and resilience; builds trust across diverse teams and is effective in navigating challenging situations and strong personalities.
Strong focus on business partnership and high degree of discretion and confidentiality. 

 

*Pursuant to local law, Colliers is disclosing the following information:*

*Area/Location Specific: Atlanta, GA*

*Approximate Compensation Range for this Role: up to $195,000 per annum*

*Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all national* *locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.*

#LI-AS1

#LI-Onsite

**Make your next move an expert one and** ***join us*** **as we lead the industry into the future.**

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The employer will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

Direct applicants only please, no agencies.

Colliers respects diversity and is an equal opportunity employer. No employee or applicant for employment will be discriminated against on the basis of any actual or perceived membership in any protected category including race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. If you are a qualified applicant who requires reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact accommodations@colliers.com for assistance.
